items.headline: ACEREZ opens second round of Central-West Orana community grants (~$1.9m)
items.summary: ACEREZ — the ACCIONA/COBRA/Endeavour Energy consortium building the Central-West Orana REZ transmission project — opens Round 2 of its community grants program today (10 August), making almost $1.9 million available in grants of roughly $3,000 to $1 million. Eligible applicants include not-for-profits, Aboriginal organisations, councils and volunteer groups, for projects spanning public amenities, education, sport, agriculture, health and Indigenous community support; the round follows a first round that backed 46 projects across the region.
items.so_what: Community-benefit spending is EnergyCo's most direct lever for building and defending social licence in the state's most-advanced zone, and this round lands while the upper-house inquiry's finding that REZ consultation gave communities 'no meaningful influence' is still fresh — making the visibility, reach and fairness of the grants a live test of engagement credibility. Watch for the tenor of local uptake and commentary (equitable distribution across affected LGAs, whether it is read as genuine benefit-sharing or as buying acquiescence) as an early read on whether benefit programs are moving community sentiment in Central-West Orana ahead of the 11–15 August roadshow.
